## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour.

## Validation

List relevant automated checks and any hardware checks. State which hardware behaviour remains unverified. Include clean screenshots for visible changes.

## Review

- [ ] Photos, collections, preferences and certificate identity remain intact.
- [ ] Remote navigation and optional platform capabilities are handled where relevant.
- [ ] No personal data, credentials, device records or generated packages are included.
- [ ] Artwork provenance and third-party notices are preserved where relevant.
